thread.title: Guess Co-Founder Paul Marciano Gives up Daily Duties Amid Probe for Improper Conduct

title: Guess Co-Founder Paul Marciano Gives up Daily Duties Amid Probe for Improper Conduct
text:
Guess Co-Founder Paul Marciano Gives up Daily Duties Amid Probe for Improper Conduct Feb. 20, 2018, at 9:22 a.m. Guess Co-Founder Paul Marciano Gives up Daily Duties Amid Probe for Improper Conduct Share FILE PHOTO: The logo of Guess is seen on an outlet store in Metzingen, Germany, June 16, 2017. REUTERS/Michaela Rehle Reuters 
(Reuters) - Guess? Inc said on Tuesday its co-founder, Paul Marciano, will relinquish his day-to-day responsibilities at the company, on an unpaid basis, following allegations of improper conduct. http://reut.rs/2EEztp8 
Earlier this month, model and actress Kate Upton tweeted, accusing Marciano of using his power to harass women. 
The fashion retailer's board in early February had formed a special committee, made up of two independent directors, to oversee an ongoing investigation into allegations against Marciano. 
(Reporting By Aparajita Saxena in Bengaluru; Editing by Bernard Orr)
